enumeration.changed_files: All 89 titles, bodies and changed-file inventories screened. GraphQL returned 89 pull requests with hasNextPage=false. matching_prs.title: Support ablation variants in Pi smoke runner

diff_evidence: variant_runtime accepts ablation:<id>, looks up its removed_component and includes it in the instruction. The code still passes the original skill paths to the invocation.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Verify the experimental manipulation in the input itself. An instruction to ignore a component cannot establish how the model would behave if the component were absent.
matching_prs.outcome_caveat: Merged as instruction-simulated smoke support with no test-file change. #20 subsequently replaces this as the basis for materialized causal ablations.

matching_prs.title: Add eval-framework docs: architecture, abstractions, authoring guide, and roadmap
matching_prs.weakness: The project’s authoring practices had produced leaky keyword checks, trigger meta-prompts and cases that could keep passing without distinguishing an improved response.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Document a paired authoring workflow with real fixtures, both positive and forbidden evidence, stronger artifact oracles where needed, and a rule for adding or pruning cases after observed failures.
diff_evidence: The authoring guide explicitly describes the meta-prompt problem, presents a rendered-artifact oracle example, and separates tune/holdout/holdback. The roadmap proposes exposing whether a score rests on a strong or demo oracle.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Build the check around real inputs and the artifact a user receives. Retain cases that discriminate outcomes and reserve held-out examples for verification.
matching_prs.outcome_caveat: A design and guidance PR with no changed test files. #19 and #22 subsequently propose and implement concrete checks of evaluator behavior.

matching_prs.title: Trustworthy-measurement expansion: external-review gaps (G1–G6), contamination + judge-robustness probes, tool-using judge, and audit hardening
matching_prs.classification: Explicit evaluation-method audit with test repairs
matching_prs.weakness: An always-passing judge could look consistent, and skipped dependent assertions could veto a case or alter its denominator. The initial tests missed order sensitivity.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Probe judges with empty and master-key answers and reversed order. Check skipped and running critical dependents, prerequisites and consensus order explicitly.
diff_evidence: Separate tests establish that a running critical failure vetoes, a skipped critical dependent does not veto, a skipped soft dependent leaves the denominator, and a master-key vulnerability is attributed to the right control.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Test the judge with inputs it must reject. Permute declarations when semantics promise order independence.
matching_prs.outcome_caveat: The probes show specific flaws in controlled inputs. A passing probe does not certify a judge generally.

limitations: This repository builds an evaluation system. Matches distinguish explicit test audits and concrete testing or evaluation-method repairs from new product features that merely have accompanying tests. Documentation-only design proposals are identified as such. Counts are PR records, not independent shipped remedies.

Hosted check status is the GitHub rollup for the exact head, not proof that every meaningful input or live provider was exercised. Most historical runs, benchmarks and claimed mutation sweeps were not rerun. Independent runs in this audit were limited to the two focused #102 mutants and their unmutated controls.

Recorded provider fixtures and deliberately bad judges provide bounded evidence about the included cases. Fresh paid or credentialed integrations were not run. A PR’s state and its final diff may differ from earlier revisions or transplants into other PRs.

independent_verification.method: Two independently executed focused unittest comparisons with isolated temporary files and a minimal environment. Replaced one condition at a time on the PR base, running the old test file and its PR replacement against the same source. All four unmutated controls passed.
